business_problem: Lendlease needed a scalable way to turn building, occupancy, and workplace data into practical operating decisions as hybrid work, sustainability pressure, and real-estate cost demands reshaped customer expectations.
solution_summary: Lendlease Digital partnered with Accenture to bring Podium Property Insights for Workplace (PPI) to market as a cloud-based software service for connected buildings. The platform aggregates data captured throughout a building and combines digital twins, analytics, and AI to generate real-time dashboards and reports for workplace managers. Those outputs help customers understand how space is being used and predict near-term demand so they can adjust cleaning schedules, kitchen supplies, front- and back-office staffing, and longer-term leasing plans. The design focuses on turning building telemetry into an operating product rather than a static reporting layer, with AI supporting attendance prediction and dynamic workplace management. By packaging the service as part of the Podium Suite, Lendlease created a reusable insights platform that helps customers run more intelligent workplaces, improve employee experience, and align occupancy decisions with sustainability and cost goals.
